req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that when the player list is empty, a GET request to /players should return an HTTP 200 status code and an empty JSON array. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_get_empty_player_list_positive
expected: Response body is an empty JSON array.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Ensure the database is empty for this test
# This is a positive test case
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == []

tests.name: test_get_players_with_invalid_method
expected: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Negative test case: using POST instead of GET
try:
    response = client.post('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 405
except AssertionError as e:
    print(f"AssertionError: {e}")

tests.name: test_get_players_boundary_case
preconditions: The players table has exactly one player.
expected: Response body contains exactly one player.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Boundary test case: exactly one player in the database
# Precondition: Ensure the database has exactly one player
# This setup is assumed to be done outside of this test
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 1
